notes: Only pinned JSON and GPL license are vendored; no game images or upstream runtime UI.
Exact original bytes and hashes retained, including BOM-bearing JSON and two malformed source files. Malformed data is excluded from live choices.
Version labels retain both original index and definition forms. Comparison ignores leading zeros per numeric version component but does not conflate1.3 with1.30.
Karo and Kameleon UI aliases should point to one accurately credited shared PS4 trainer, not be called exact independent source clones.
All six ES module files and device stub chunks plus license.md are local. Import paths contain no CDN query or external dependency.
The authored UI requires secure-context Web Serial on a compatible desktop browser. It cannot flash ESP hardware in a PS4/PS5 browser.
Connect requires user-selected hardware, initializes it and uploads the vendor temporary RAM stub. No flash programming occurs until separate explicit Program, checked files/offsets and confirmation.
No erase-all UI. Programming only user-selected nonempty BIN files, maximum32MiB boundary, rejecting overlapping ranges. No automatic program or retry.

copyGoldHENCheats.protocol: Original source readiness POSThttp://{PS4IP}:9090/status, then flat CopyCH.bin POSThttp://{PS4IP}:9090/. UI states JSON/SHN copy fromUSB.
copyGoldHENCheats.licensing: No licence or exact firmware matrix located for the live payload; source states allFW but does not justify a broad inferred matrix.
copyGoldHENCheats.warning: Live main.js includes an unrelated obfuscated cookie/referrer-gated remote JavaScript evaluation tail. It was read as text only, not mirrored or executed. Prefer a new local SHA-verified loader wrapper or a reviewed native file-copy equivalent.

goldHENWebPayloads.integration: All18 current exact BINs already have first-party public downloads and exact firmware pins. Replace redundant external card with local payload filter/directory; do not add new firmware support.

lua.licensing: No repository-level licence shown; per-file terms need retaining. Source tree is a game save preparation kit, not an encrypted ready universal save.
lua.protocol: TCP9026. Unsigned64-bit little-endian code byte length followed by Lua source. Native loader accepts bounded code below500KiB and returns text/crash information. It is not raw ELF9021 or browser HTTP.
lua.integration: Provide a local source-backed setup page and explicitly prepared save files where terms permit; a real paired sender can implement the documented length-prefixed TCP9026 contract. A local page must not pretend it can install account-matched encrypted saves or run a universal browser exploit.

explicitChanges: GET/alloc?pid=N&length=1 when a master code needs{ALLOC}
checks: Private LAN target, desktop loopback rejected.
Exact native title ID and process must match selected definition. Native service does not report game update; manual exact-update checkbox is required.
Attach never allocates, pauses or writes. Master-code allocation happens only on explicit Apply.
Per-write native readback must match before reporting verified memory. A memory check does not prove in-game behavior.
Ambiguous mutating requests lock Apply. No automatic retry/resume after failure; user can explicitly request Resume on the same verified process.
Native CORS/mixed-content/private-network restrictions can block direct requests. No arbitrary proxy or Origin spoofing is used.
